children: MIC Electronics Limited, an LED display solutions and intelligent communication systems provider, has set up a wholly-owned subsidiary, MIC Defence Systems Private Limited to focus on Defence electronics, unmanned systems, surveillance, electronic warfare, AI-based defence technologies and cybersecurity.

It will focus on emerging and technology-intensive areas including electronic warfare, artificial intelligence-based defence technologies and cybersecurity solutions, along with other allied products and services.

“The new entity provides MIC Electronics with a dedicated platform to focus on opportunities across the evolving defence technology landscape, covering both established defence electronics applications and emerging technology domains, Rakshit Mathur, Chief Executive Officer of MIC Electronics Limited, said here in a statement on Tuesday.

title: MIC Electronics sets up arm for Defence, aerospace business
